title: 第一卷 第23章 在场的诸位都得死第一卷 第24章 激战全军覆灭
lines: 迷雾森林，阴冷而潮湿。
周家修士在雷域外，等了足足一天一夜，已显得不太耐烦。
一名周家修士昏昏欲睡道：“十二个时辰过去，叶无尘还没走出雷域，看来他已经被雷劫劈成灰了，咱们没必要继续守着了吧？”
“凡位境修士，根本无人能在雷域中支撑一个时辰以上，叶无尘断无存活可能性！”
黑衣男子点点头，狭长的眸光中闪烁着寒芒，随后又话锋一转道：“不过苏晴雨乃筑法境强者，恐怕没那么容易死去，小心驶得万年船，咱们还需要再等待几日。”
“你们就守在这雷域出口吧，我先去别的地方逛逛！”
周泽文百无聊赖，耐心耗尽。
这群周家修士，都是他的奴仆，旁人自然不敢发出任何意见。
“周少，等等！”
蓦然间，黑衣男子眼皮猛跳，只见那雷域迷雾之中，竟浮现出了一道小小的身影，看起来约莫六七岁孩童的高度。
周泽文停住了脚步，看着迷雾中的身影，瞳孔一阵剧烈收缩，难以置信道：“那妖孽居然还活着？不可能，这绝对不可能！”
“会不会是错觉啊？”
其余周家修士也都揉了揉眼睛，生怕是自己看错了。
迷雾森林中，一片寂静！
只有脚步声渐渐逼近，带给人极大压迫感。
终于，迷雾消散了部分，那小小的身影，一张稚嫩的脸庞隐约显露。
“真的是他！”
周家修士顿时炸开了锅，无不头皮发麻，汗毛倒竖。
这怎么可能！
一个三岁半的小孩，闯进九死一生的雷域，历经十二个时辰，居然还能活着走出，太天方夜谭了！
“而且，他还中了我的毒镖，凡位境修士，三个时辰内必然毒发身亡才对。”
黑衣男子倒吸一口凉气，内心生出一股对未知的恐惧感。
很快，叶无尘自雷域中走出，他已经换了一身新衣裳，而且身体也长高了不少，给人一种已经过去漫长的一年，长大一岁的错觉。
“原来都在啊，很好，免得麻烦我四处去寻找你们！”
叶无尘走出雷域后，看了一眼站在十几米外的周家修士，见人员完整，当即满意的点了点头。
“你，你居然没死！”
周泽文声音都有些颤抖，不可置信。
“今天，在场的诸位都得死！”
叶无尘压低了声音，双眸骤然凌厉，带给人一种可怖的杀伐气息。
一时间，周家众人都不寒而栗。
这三岁小孩身上爆发出来的肃杀之气，居然丝毫不弱于那些久经沙场的万人敌！
“只是错觉，都不要慌张。”
黑衣男子开口，保持着冷静道：“这小子根本就是在故弄玄虚，只要苏晴雨未曾恢复修为，我们便无需有任何忌惮。”
“也对，现在还未曾见到苏晴雨的身影，看来她已毒发身亡，哈哈哈哈，真是虚惊一场。”
周家修士得到黑衣男子的提醒后，全都回过神来。
对啊，他们害怕的只是苏晴雨，又并非叶无尘。
“一个三岁的小鬼头而已，就算你能活着走出雷域，也逃不出我们的手掌心！”
“不错，自己送上门来找死，愚蠢。”
周家修士全都哄堂大笑。
content_en:
The misty forest is cold and humid.
The monks of the Zhou family had been waiting outside Leiyu for a full day and night, and they already seemed impatient.
A monk from the Zhou family said drowsily: "Twelve hours have passed, and Ye Wuchen hasn't walked out of the thunder field yet. It seems that he has been turned into ashes by the thunder. There is no need for us to continue to guard him, right?"
"No mortal monk can survive in the thunder field for more than an hour. Ye Wuchen has no chance of survival!"
The man in black nodded, a cold light flashed in his narrow eyes, and then changed the topic: "But Su Qingyu is a strong man in the Dharma-Constructing Realm, so I'm afraid he won't die that easily. Be careful to sail the ten-thousand-year ship, we still need to wait a few more days."
"You guys just stay at the exit of this thunder field, I'll go shopping somewhere else first!"
Zhou Zewen was bored and his patience was exhausted.
These Zhou family monks were all his slaves, so others naturally did not dare to express any opinions.
"Master Zhou, wait!"
Suddenly, the man in black's eyelids twitched, and he saw a small figure emerging from the fog of the thunder field, which looked to be about the height of a six or seven-year-old child.
Zhou Zewen stopped and looked at the figure in the mist. His pupils shrank violently and he said in disbelief: "That monster is still alive? Impossible, this is absolutely impossible!"
"Could it be an illusion?"
The other Zhou family monks also rubbed their eyes, fearing that they had seen it wrong.
There was silence in the misty forest!
Only the sound of footsteps gradually approaching, giving people a great sense of oppression.
Finally, the fog partially dissipated, and the small figure and childish face were vaguely revealed.
"It's really him!"
The monks of the Zhou family immediately exploded, their scalps became numb and their hairs stood on end.
How is this possible!
A three-and-a-half-year-old child broke into a minefield where he had a near chance of death. After twelve hours, he actually managed to come out alive. It was a fantasy!
"Moreover, he was hit by my poison dart. A mortal monk will definitely be poisoned and die within three hours."
The man in black took a breath, feeling a sense of fear of the unknown in his heart.
Soon, Ye Wuchen walked out of the thunder field. He had changed into new clothes, and his body had grown a lot, giving people the illusion that a long year had passed and he was one year older.
"It turns out they are all here. Very good. You don't have to bother me going around looking for you!"
After Ye Wuchen walked out of the mine field, he glanced at the Zhou family monks who were standing more than ten meters away. Seeing that everyone was intact, he immediately nodded with satisfaction.
"You, you're not dead!"
Zhou Zewen's voice was trembling in disbelief.
"Today, everyone present will die!"
Ye Wuchen lowered his voice, his eyes suddenly sharp, giving people a terrifying murderous aura.
For a moment, everyone in the Zhou family shuddered.
The murderous aura that erupted from this three-year-old child was actually not weaker than those who had been on the battlefield for ten thousand years!
"It's just an illusion, don't panic."
The man in black opened his mouth and said calmly: "This kid is just trying to make a fool of himself. As long as Su Qingyu has not recovered her cultivation, we don't need to have any worries."
"That's right, I haven't seen Su Qingyu yet. It seems that she has died of poison. Hahahaha, it's really a false alarm."
After being reminded by the man in black, the Zhou family monks all came to their senses.
Yes, they were only afraid of Su Qingyu, not Ye Wuchen.
"You're just a three-year-old little devil. Even if you can get out of the minefield alive, you can't escape from our hands!"
"That's right. It's stupid to send someone to your door to seek death."
All the Zhou family monks burst into laughter.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 23 Everyone present must die Volume 1 Chapter 24 Fierce battle and the entire army is destroyed
